topics.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid affair and spy scandal
topics.explanation: Jensen Huang has stepped down as CEO of Nvidia following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. The scandal has triggered investigations by Congress into the company's China chip sales and its past dealings with the Trump administration.
topics.why_it_matters: As a central player in the AI boom, Nvidia's leadership crisis and potential regulatory fallout are creating significant market volatility and uncertainty for the broader AI sector.

topics.title: Microsoft global cloud outage causes widespread disruption
topics.explanation: A massive, multi-day outage affecting Microsoft's Outlook, Teams, and 365 services has impacted millions of users and government infrastructure worldwide. While the company reports gradual service restoration, the incident has raised concerns about the stability of global cloud dependencies.
topics.why_it_matters: Large-scale outages in critical cloud infrastructure can paralyze businesses and government operations, potentially leading to significant financial liabilities for the provider.

topics.title: US wholesale inflation rises as Fed officials signal need for more rate hikes
topics.explanation: US producer price index (PPI) data showed wholesale inflation climbing at its fastest pace since 2022, while Federal Reserve officials have indicated that inflation remains too high and further interest rate tightening may be necessary.
topics.why_it_matters: Higher-than-expected inflation and hawkish central bank policy typically pressure bond markets and can increase borrowing costs for businesses and consumers.

topics.title: Global oil markets swing to surplus as Gulf shipments rebound
topics.explanation: Global oil supply has moved into a surplus as shipments from the Gulf region recover and Russian crude production increases. Despite this, geopolitical risks in the Middle East continue to influence energy market pricing.
topics.why_it_matters: Shifts in global oil supply and demand dynamics directly impact energy costs, which are a key component of broader economic inflation.

topics.title: Anthropic IPO draws high investor demand despite valuation concerns
topics.explanation: AI company Anthropic is preparing for an IPO with a reported target valuation of $1.4 trillion. The offering has attracted significant interest, though institutional investors from mainland China and Hong Kong have been excluded from participating.
topics.why_it_matters: The IPO serves as a major test for investor appetite in the AI sector, especially as companies face high compute costs and cash burn rates.
